name: Tra Su Cajuput Forest
kicker: Flooded cajuput forest west of the Hậu
summary: Flooded cajuput forest 23 km out: walk the bamboo bridge and boat the water for a half day among the birds. The gate is 120,000 VND. The motorboat and the rowboat are 60,000 VND each on the standing price page. Buy the boat if the water is the visit. September to November is the flood window on the English card.
getThere: By road, 23 km from Châu Đốc. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Cajuput trunks standing in duckweed at Rừng tràm Trà Sư

notice.title: The gate ticket leaves out the boat
notice.body: The standing price is 120,000 VND at the gate. The motorboat and the rowboat are 60,000 VND each. Buy the boat if you came for the water. The spillway on the Vĩnh Tế canal is a separate trip. Confirm the boat price at the gate.

body: Trà Sư is the wetland west of the Hậu. The rural tourism page calls it a conservation forest of more than 845 ha, planted from the 1980s on acid lowland. The charms chapter says 850 ha. You walk the bamboo bridge and take a tắc ráng, a motor sampan, or a rowed three-plank boat through duckweed, lotus, and water hyacinth, watching birds. The Châu Đốc place page names more than 70 bird types.

The operator page calls the bamboo bridge 2.2 km. The rural tourism page says the bridge Vạn bước xuyên rừng is longer than 3,800 m. A guide on the standing price page is 300,000 VND for up to 3 hours.

Go in flood season if the water is the point. The English card says September to November. The Vietnamese place page says high water from August to November, and names that window for Trà Sư and the floating villages. Dry-season green is also described. Buy the boat ticket if the water is the visit you wanted.

figures.alt: Green flooded forest at Tra Su with still water in the foreground

gettingThere: The charms chapter places the forest 23 km from Châu Đốc. Drive minutes were not printed. Minutes are check on arrival. The spillway trip on the Vĩnh Tế canal is a separate product on the operator page.

legs.heading: From Châu Đốc
legs.body: By road, 23 km on the Vietnam Tourism charms chapter. Minutes are check on arrival.

hours: 06:30–18:30 every day, on an operator post for the April 2026 holiday. The price page prints a bicycle loop of 07:00–16:00. A Vietnam Tourism story prints bird decks at 06:00–09:00 and 14:00–19:00. 19:00 sits after the 18:30 close. Confirm the last boat at the gate.
closed: No weekly closing day is printed on the operator post. Check the board on arrival.
admissionNote: Standing prices from 1 November 2024: gate 120,000 VND a guest. Motorboat 60,000 VND a guest return. Rowboat 60,000 VND a guest. Children under 1.3 m free. From 1.3 m, the adult price. A guide is 300,000 VND for up to 3 hours. The observation tower is not on that table. Spillway trips are separate: 500,000 VND a guest for a group under 5, or 100,000 VND a guest return for a group of 5 or more. Confirm the boat price at the gate.
